name: Your product here
tagline: Reach Claude users at the exact moment they're picking tools.
_help: Edit only this file to change sponsors. One sponsor: set demo:false and fill name/tagline/url (logo = image URL, optional). Several sponsors (bar only): add "sponsors": [{"name","tagline","url","logo","demo"}] and they all scroll in the bar and show in its expanded list; the top-level fields still drive the results card. bar: ticker fixed to the bottom of every page; desktop hover or a tap on phones opens the full list; visitors can hide it with x. card: one card after the top 5 results; keywords (optional) limit the card to prompts containing one of them. demo:true labels an entry 'Example sponsor' and should point url at /sponsor/. active:false hides the bar and shows a plain house card linking to /sponsor/.
